title: Law to create one online application for senior and disability rent freeze programs
summary: This bill would require the Department of Finance and the Department of Housing Preservation and Development to jointly build a single online and paper application and recertification system for the Senior Citizen Rent Increase Exemption and Disability Rent Increase Exemption programs by July 1, 2028. It would also require agencies to promote public awareness of the system on city websites related to public assistance or rent increase exemptions. Paper applications would still be accepted alongside the new system.
